There is a unisex accessible toilet on the ground floor that is on level access from the entrance.

Our team does all it can to make the venue as accessible as possible for people with different needs.

findings.value: Box Office, Kiosk and the ground-floor accessible toilet have level access from the entrance. Screens two and three, plus Studios four and five, are reached by ramp. Screen 1 and the upper-floor bar and kitchen have no lift; staff can help people on the stairs with a stair climber. Carers with a CEA card get one free ticket, booked by phone. A wheelchair can be borrowed.

evidence.quote: There is level access into the cinema and to Box Office, Coffee, the Kiosk and the accessible toilet.
Screens 2 and 3 and Studios 4 and 5 are accessible via a ramp.
Screen 1, Bar Paragon and the Kitchen are all upstairs. The only way to access upstairs is via our stairs. There is no lift in the building.
we can assist you with the use of our stair climber (max load 150kg) which is operated by our trained managers.
We accept Cinema Exhibitor's Association (CEA) Cards and other carer ID cards which entitle a person who needs assistance to ONE free ticket
There is a wheelchair that can be borrowed whilst in the venue.

findings.value: Prices are set by day: adults pay £4.99 Monday to Wednesday, £7.75 on Thursday and £12.00 Friday to Sunday, with lower prices for under 14s, over 60s, students and families. Studios 4 and 5 cost £10 to £15. 3D adds £2.50 a ticket.
